segments.name: Comfort Products
segments.description: Designs and manufactures premium comfort products built on proprietary Hyper-Elastic Polymer technology, sold direct-to-consumer and through wholesale retail partners.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment that operates an omni-channel distribution strategy which allows the Company to offer a seamless shopping experience to its customers across multiple sales channels.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay Purple directly through its e-commerce site, showrooms, contact center and online marketplaces, and wholesale retail partners pay for products sold to their customers.
revenueModel.evidence: We market and sell our products via our direct-to-consumer channel, which includes Purple.com (our direct-to-consumer e-commerce), Purple showrooms, our customer contact center and online marketplaces (collectively "DTC"), and our wholesale channel through retail brick-and-mortar and online wholesale partners.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company initiated a restructuring plan to close its Grantsville and Salt Lake City, Utah manufacturing facilities and consolidate mattress production in its Georgia plant, completed in May 2025.
changes.evidence: The Company's Restructuring Plan includes the permanent closure of its Grantsville and Salt Lake City, Utah manufacturing facilities to consolidate mattress production in its Georgia plant, and a headcount reduction at the Company's Utah headquarters to drive additional operating efficiencies.
